_comment: Warp Agent Permissions — TEMPLATE (NOT applied automatically) — JSON variant of warp-agent-permissions.template.toml
_where: Live file: ~/.warp/settings.toml (or ~/.dotfiles/warp/.warp/settings.toml) — Warp docs: Settings > Agents > Profiles > Permissions
_usage: Copy the object under agents.execution_profiles.default into your real settings file after review. Denylist always wins over allowlist and always_allow. Cmd+Shift+I Run until completion bypasses denylist for one task only.
_goal: Monitored-install marathon children: auto-run bun, git worktree, vm-install-one, allbrew generate, bun test; still ask for rm, eval/exec/source, scp/rsync, bare curl/wget

how_to_apply: 4. Denylist match ALWAYS prompts — remove/narrow entries that collide with marathon commands
5. For single YOLO run: Cmd+Shift+I Run until completion
false_gates: blocked status = waiting for YOUR Warp command accept UI
Product hangs (allbrew checkbox, hung brew install) are NOT denylist gates
Host brew install stays disallowed by PROMPT policy even if Warp allows brew binary for VM helper
